notes.title: Version 0.0.3 is out!
notes.notes:
Excited to share the newest update to Mustdashe! This update primarily introduces a new level and builds the foundation for more sophisticated Steamworks integration.

New Targets

    Blocks
    Giant mustache
    Arcade screen


New Levels

    Arcade


Updated Levels

    Suburbs
    Sandbox


UX Improvements

    Crosshair sprite update
Bulleted list

Gameplay Tweaks

    Scoring system has been reworked to prioritize achievements


Bug Fixes

    Steam achievements are properly awarded
    Grill achievement logic is fixed
    Rock achievement logic is fixed



Tasks for 0.0.4 are mostly defined, focusing on back-end functionality and Steamworks integration. However, there will certainly be some UX updates to existing levels, as well as new targets and interactive level elements. Looking at a week or so until the next update, stay tuned!

notes.title: Version 0.0.2 is out!
notes.notes:
Happy to announce that the first update to Mustdashe is complete. This update addresses several minor improvements as well as user-suggested features and behind-the-scenes functionality.

New Targets

     Cat
     Grill


New Levels

     Sandbox


Updated Levels

    Town Square
     Suburbs


UX Improvements

    Punch impact
    Gameplay analytics
    Controls menu page


Gameplay Tweaks

    Clock bonus reduced to 15 seconds from 30


Bug Fixes

    Achievement percentage displays correctly in Stats page


Tasks for Version 0.0.3 have already been defined and should be completed in the near future. New bugs and user-reported issues will be prioritized, but nothing that's currently in progress will be left behind for a later update. Lots of new content on its way!
